commentary: With market breadth registering a muted 32 under a WEAK scanner gate, defensive discipline is paramount despite the Nifty reclaiming the 23,000 benchmark. Stan Weinstein's stage framework warns against aggressive commitments when breadth diverges from headline indices, favoring only Stage 2 breakouts supported by clear accumulation. William O'Neil's market-direction discipline reminds us that three out of four equities mirror the broader market's undertone. In this environment, we enforce progressive exposure, demand rigorous CANSLIM earnings qualification, and cut losses ruthlessly at predetermined stops.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: Price reclaims EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on 2.42x volume with MACD crossing into positive territory, testing neckline resistance. Relative strength remains unproven given erratic micro-cap volatility.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Micro-cap financial services firm burdened by recurring operational losses, irregular revenue generation, and negative return ratios. It lacks CANSLIM-style institutional sponsorship and operational predictability.
21STCENMGM.risk: Thesis fails on a decisive break below 47.58; cut losses immediately without hesitation.

63MOONS.technical: Double bottom base with price reclaiming the rising 21-EMA and holding above the 50 and 200 SMAs. MACD stays positive, though breakout volume requires further confirmation.
63MOONS.fundamental: Software vendor supported by subsidiary cybersecurity order flow, yet trailing operating performance remains pressured by net losses and sub-par returns on capital, missing CANSLIM benchmarks.
63MOONS.risk: Setup fails on a breakdown below the 849.29 swing floor; honor strict stop discipline.

AAATECH.technical: Cleared 20-session resistance on 1.85x volume, trading constructively above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 62 indicates steady accumulation without near-term overbought exhaustion.
AAATECH.fundamental: Niche IT security auditor exhibiting respectable operational margins, but top-line revenue contracted 11% YoY while profit grew just 6%, falling short of O'Neil's 25% earnings acceleration threshold.
AAATECH.risk: Thesis invalidates if price drops below 102.52; cut risk immediately to protect capital.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: SEPA breakout clearing 20-day highs backed by an extraordinary 67.7x volume surge. The stock is positioned above its 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages with constructive momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Leading active pharmaceutical ingredient player showing top-line revival (+19% YoY), but net profit declined 4.1% on input cost inflation and moderate ROCE (~12%), capping CANSLIM quality.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Breaching the 420.40 pivot low invalidates the SEPA breakout; cut losses swiftly.

ABDL.technical: Forming an orderly double bottom above the rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 1.46x volume. RSI at 52 shows quiet accumulation near the pivot.
ABDL.fundamental: Spirits manufacturer delivering 15.8% revenue growth and record 10M case volumes. Gross margins improved to 45.3%, but EBITDA margins dipped to 12.4%, keeping EPS growth below 25%.
ABDL.risk: Thesis breaks down on a close below 705.04; execute disciplined stop exit.

ACUTAAS.technical: High-velocity double bottom breakout to fresh 52-week highs on 3.67x volume. Exemplary relative strength with RSI at 69 confirms top-tier institutional accumulation above all key moving averages.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM credentials with Q2 FY27 profit up 71.4% and revenue climbing 42.7%. EBITDA margins expanded to 40.3%, propelled by advanced pharma intermediates, CDMO contracts, and semiconductor expansion.
ACUTAAS.risk: Failure below the 3555.57 swing trigger invalidates the base pivot; cut loss immediately.
